test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statements.

Statements:

1. All springs are brooks.

2. Some brooks are creeks.

3. No creek is tap.

Conclusions:

I. Some taps are creeks.

Il. No spring is tap.

IIl. Some brooks are springs.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

1. All springs are brooks.

2. Some brooks are creeks.

3. No creek is tap.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a12de11c7a0c0d0de07d6c1bfe7c044bfd93806e7c82132cb59f4f04e613ad5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some taps are creeks - False (Because, No creek is tap).

II. No spring is tap - False (Because, No definite relation given between spring and tap, So, No spring is tap can be possible only).

III. Some brooks are springs - True (Because, All springs are brooks implies that Some brooks are springs also).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
